correctness.rationale: For P a permutation of q>=2 distinct letters and k>=1, greedy embedding in opposite linear block orders consumes 1+des+equal or 1+asc+equal blocks. Replacing an equality by xy,yx is budget preserving; the one-budget-saturated insertion argument uses boundary letters and telescoping to show every shorter common word extends. Thus maximal words are adjacent-distinct with exactly k-1 rises and falls, length 2k-1. The transfer recurrence is the classical Smirnov descent generating function, and palindromes are determined by q choices initially and q-1 for each of k-1 first-half steps. All q,k logical boundaries included. Direct independently constructed two-host subsequence enumeration produced (q,k,maximal,palindromes)=(2,3,2,2),(3,3,36,12),(4,2,28,12),(5,2,60,20); no finite check substitutes for the proof.
